description: A futuristic, Iron Man-inspired AI assistant control panel with a cyan/electric blue sci-fi HUD aesthetic. Focuses on glass-morphism panels, animated central elements (arc reactor), terminal text reveals, and high-contrast data visualization.
global_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='mic-toggle-button', data-testid='system-status').
Use strictly .js extension for React components, NOT .tsx.
Hardware-accelerated CSS animations for scanlines, rotations, and pulses.
Avoid generic purple gradients. Stick strictly to the Electric Cyan, Deep Blue, and Void Black color palette.
Use Lucide-React icons for UI elements.
The interface must feel like a Control Room - dense, grid-based, and highly utilized.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-heading font-bold tracking-tighter text-cyan-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)]

layout_spacing.container: h-screen w-full bg-slate-950 overflow-hidden relative text-white
layout_spacing.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 md:grid-rows-3 gap-4 p-4 md:p-6 h-full
layout_spacing.panels: border border-cyan-500/20 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-lg p-4 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.1)_inset]

hud_panel.classes: relative overflow-hidden border border-cyan-500/30 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl p-6
hud_panel.effects: Include an absolutely positioned overlay for a scanline effect: `bg-[linear-gradient(to_bottom,transparent_50%,rgba(0,229,255,0.05)_50%)] bg-[length:100%_4px]`.

arc_reactor.classes: relative flex items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4 border-cyan-500/50 shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,229,255,0.4)]
arc_reactor.animation: Outer rings should use `animate-[spin_10s_linear_infinite]`, inner core should pulse opacity.

glass_button.classes: px-4 py-2 border border-cyan-500/50 text-cyan-400 bg-cyan-950/20 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.4)] transition-all uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-heading cursor-pointer rounded-md backdrop-blur-sm

MainDashboard.description: Main wrapper. 100vh, fixed, hidden scrollbars. Contains the background grid texture.

SystemStatus.description: Displays Edge Agent, Brain, Mic, Camera status using green/red text and pulsing dots.

CentralAI.description: Center focus. Holds the Animated Arc Reactor and the Live Voice Activation Waveform.
CentralAI.grid_span: col-span-2 row-span-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative

MorningReport.description: Right panel. Weather, calendar agenda. Text is monospace, data-heavy.

FaceIDPanel.description: Right side corner. Shows user silhouette placeholder with cyan scanning laser animations overlay.

TranscriptPanel.description: Bottom span. Terminal-like text streaming for user/JARVIS dialogue.

QuickActions.description: Bottom right/left blocks. Buttons for Open Spotify, Web Search, etc.

media.description: Blue metallic grid texture. Apply with low opacity (e.g., opacity-10 or blend-overlay) behind the main UI.
Abstract blue concentric rings. Can be used as a fallback background inside the central HUD component.
Silhouette of a man. Use in the Face Registration/ID panel with a cyan scanline overlay simulating a face scan.

animations.pulse_glow: @keyframes pulse-glow { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2); } 50% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 30px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.6); } }
animations.scanline: Vertical translating div with a cyan linear gradient acting as a scanning laser. Use Framer Motion or pure CSS.
animations.waveform: Multiple vertical bars using Framer Motion to scale vertically based on simulated audio input.
